title: v2 external export must keep the '-- Dashboard --' datasource reference untouched
answers: Why does a panel using the Dashboard datasource show Random Walk data after importing a shared v2 dashboard?
Share dashboard with another instance breaks panels that reuse another panel's query results
Which datasource references does makeExportableV2 skip when anonymizing?
exported v2 dashboard loses -- Dashboard -- datasource name
body:
Symptom: A v2 dashboard is exported with "Share dashboard with another instance" and reimported. A panel that reuses another panel's results (the -- Dashboard -- datasource) then falls back to Grafana's built-in datasource and shows generated Random Walk data.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts:makeExportableV2 handled `dataQueryKind.datasource.name === '-- Dashboard --'` like an instance-specific UID. It removed the name and attached datasource-remapping labels.
Fix pattern: In the per-query loop, return early when the name equals SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY (app/plugins/datasource/dashboard/constants). This check comes before the template-variable branch, label generation and UID removal, so the query keeps `datasource: { name: '-- Dashboard --' }` and gets no labels.
Constraints: Only this exact reference is exempt, whether the query group is 'datasource' or 'dashboard'. Other built-ins are still anonymized: `grafana` gets an ExportLabel such as 'grafana-1', and Prometheus etc. get ExportLabel/ExportDatasourceName. Mixed panels keep the '-- Mixed --' panel datasource. Library panels inlined during external export go through the same path, so they must also keep the reference. If you add another datasource with a stable UID across installations, it needs a similar exemption.
applies: Dashboard v2 export for external sharing (makeExportableV2 with isSharingExternally=true)
